name: canvasexpert-se
description: Use the local CanvasExpert-SE Engine for Canvas authoring, scoring, review and teacher configuration.

workspace.title: CE-SE UserInstall folder
workspace.description: Select the extracted CanvasExpert-SE folder (UserInstall) containing engine/cse.exe and context/courses.md. It runs in place; do not select Dev or UserSync. Optional UserSync holds reusable teacher setup. The Canvas credential stays in Windows Credential Manager.
